title: Hubble: Open-source notetaking app for you and your agents
summary: Hubble is an open-source notetaking application designed to serve both human users and AI agents, enabling seamless collaboration between users and their AI assistants through shared note-taking capabilities.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between human note-taking and AI agent workflows by providing a unified, open-source platform where both can create, access, and manage notes together.
why_valuable: Its open-source nature and dual-user design (humans + AI agents) make it a flexible, transparent solution for teams and individuals looking to integrate AI assistance directly into their note-taking and knowledge management workflows.
